            WHEN European.European_Value > 3.3 THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END AS max_value
    FROM 1996 general
    JOIN 1999 European ON 1996 general.id = 1999 European.id
    JOIN 2001 general ON 1999 European.id = 2001 general.id
    JOIN 2004 European ON 1999 European.id = 2004 European.id
    JOIN 2006 general ON 1999 European.id = 2006 general.id
    JOIN 2008 general ON 1999 European.id = 2008 general.id
    WHERE European.European_Value < 5.5
      AND European.European_Value > 5.8
      AND European.European_Value > 3.3

) AS subquery;
